decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out non-speaker items like charging cables and carrying cases, I focused on products with the highest reputation and user satisfaction. My consideration set includes top-tier brands like Bose and JBL, along with highly-rated value options like Raymate and INSMY, and a premium stationary system from Edifier. I ultimately chose the JBL Clip 3 because it offers the best balance of portability, brand reliability, and proven durability. With over 68,000 reviews and a 4.7-star rating, it is a low-risk purchase that fits most portable use cases perfectly.
